preconditions.description: The length of the string S must be between 1 and 100,000.
The integer K must be between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isalnum() or c == '-' for c in S)
preconditions.description: The string S must consist only of alphanumeric characters and dashes.

postconditions.expression: stdout == ''.join(group.upper() for group in groups) and len(groups) > 0
postconditions.description: The output must be the reformatted string with all characters in uppercase and groups separated by dashes.

postconditions.expression: all(len(group) == K for group in groups[1:])
postconditions.description: All groups except the first must contain exactly K characters.
The first group must contain at least one character and at most K characters.
